title: Veterinary Practice Bill at Second Reading, creating a Veterinary Council to register and discipline vets
what_it_is: A Bill at Second Reading, moved by the Minister of State for National Development on behalf of the Minister for National Development, that establishes a Veterinary Council to register veterinarians and regulate the practice of veterinary medicine in Singapore.
why_it_matters: The Minister said vets will have to be registered with the new Council and hold a valid practising certificate to practise, and that the Registrar must publish registered vets' particulars so the public can search for and verify a vet's registration status and place of practice. The maximum financial penalty for unlawful practice or misrepresentation as a vet rises from $10,000 to $50,000. Existing AVS-licensed vets will be temporarily deemed duly qualified and must obtain registration and a practising certificate within a stipulated grace period to continue practising.

key_points.point: The Bill creates a new Veterinary Council to register vets and regulate veterinary medicine, replacing the current licensing framework under the Animals and Birds Act.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the Veterinary Practice Bill establishes a new professional regulatory body, the Veterinary Council, to register veterinarians, or vets, and to regulate the practice of veterinary medicine in Singapore

key_points.point: Vets in Singapore are currently licensed under the Animals and Birds Act.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Today, vets in Singapore are licensed under the Animals and Birds Act (ABA).

key_points.point: There are close to 700 licensed vets as of end-2025, up more than five-fold over two decades.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: There are close to 700 licensed vets as of end-2025.

key_points.point: Clause 2 defines the practice of veterinary medicine and clause 3 defines who is a duly qualified vet.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Clause 2 defines the practice of veterinary medicine

key_points.point: The Government plans to eventually extend regulation to other veterinary professionals such as vet nurses, with a transition period.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we plan to eventually extend regulation to other veterinary professionals, such as vet nurses who are currently not licensed, with an appropriate transition period to allow the sector to adjust

key_points.point: The Council's composition will be a mix of public and private sector members, with members serving a maximum term of three years and eligible for re-appointment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Clause 4 provides for the Council's composition, which will comprise a mix of public and private sector members.

key_points.point: The Minister for National Development will have powers to appoint and remove Council members.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Minister for National Development will have powers to appoint and remove members

key_points.point: Clauses 17 to 19 create three classes of registration: full, restricted and specialist.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Clauses 17 to 19 provide for the registration of vets under three classes of registration, to better differentiate a vet's foundational qualification, training and practice experience.

key_points.point: The Registrar must publish certain particulars of registered vets on the Council's website so the public can verify a vet's registration status and place of practice.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Clause 24 requires the Registrar to publish on the Council's website, certain particulars of the registered vets.

key_points.point: Registered vets must obtain a practising certificate from the Council to practise veterinary medicine.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: registered vets must also obtain a practising certificate from the Council to practise veterinary medicine

key_points.point: Clause 90 provides for all AVS-licensed vets to transit to the new framework, with existing vets temporarily deemed duly qualified.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: clause 90 will provide an arrangement for all AVS-licensed vets to transit to the new framework seamlessly

key_points.point: Existing vets must obtain registration and a practising certificate within a stipulated grace period to continue practising.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Existing vets will then need to obtain registration and a practising certificate within a stipulated grace period to continue practising veterinary medicine.

key_points.point: Clause 29 does not prohibit vet nurses from practising veterinary medicine if they act under the supervision of a duly qualified vet and meet prescribed conditions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: clause 29 does not prohibit vet nurses from practising veterinary medicine so long as they act under the supervision of a duly qualified vet and in accordance with prescribed conditions, as they do today

key_points.point: The Bill raises the maximum financial penalty for offences to $50,000, benchmarked against human healthcare professions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Bill will raise the maximum financial penalty to $50,000

key_points.point: The Complaints Assessment Committee may recommend referring minor complaints for mediation by an appointed mediator.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: clause 50 allows the Complaints Assessment Committee to recommend referring a case for mediation by an appointed mediator

key_points.point: The Interim Orders Committee may suspend or impose conditions on a vet's registration for up to 18 months while disciplinary proceedings are ongoing.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: clause 66 empowers the Interim Orders Committee to either suspend or impose conditions or restrictions on a vet's registration for a period not exceeding 18 months while disciplinary proceedings are ongoing

key_points.point: Interim orders cease when the specified period ends, when revoked, or when disciplinary proceedings conclude.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Clause 71 provides that interim orders will cease to be in force either at the end of the period specified in the order, when the order is revoked or when disciplinary proceedings conclude.

key_points.point: The Minister will hear appeals against the Council's decisions, and the General Division of the High Court will hear appeals against Disciplinary Committee or Interim Orders Committee orders.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Minister will hear appeals against the Council's decisions.

key_points.point: Part 6 gives the Council power to make regulations on qualifications, continuing professional education and professional standards, subject to the Minister's approval.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Part 6 of the Bill provides powers for the Council to make regulations on qualifications for registration, continuing professional education requirements and professional standards.

key_points.point: The Bill will commence in two stages: the Veterinary Council this year, and the registration regime and disciplinary framework next year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we will commence the Bill in two stages, starting with establishing the Veterinary Council this year, followed by the remaining provisions of the Bill, including the registration regime and disciplinary framework for vets next year

key_points.point: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry said pet care must not become affordable only to the wealthy.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
key_points.quote: caring for a cat or dog or any pet must not be the preserve of the wealthy

key_points.point: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry suggested AVS track broad trends in the cost of veterinary care and share them regularly with the Committee and the Council.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
key_points.quote: I would encourage AVS to begin tracking broad trends in the cost of veterinary care and to share this regularly with the Committee and the Council.

key_points.point: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis said there is currently no university course in veterinary science available locally.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: Currently, there is no university course in veterinary science available locally.

key_points.point: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis said NParks investigated 54 cases of harm to animals involving pet groomers over the past three years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
key_points.quote: NParks investigated 54 cases of harm to animals involving pet groomers over the past three years

key_points.point: Ms Lee Hui Ying asked whether the Ministry will consider providing support and grants to vet professionals for continuing education.
key_points.speaker: Ms Lee Hui Ying
key_points.quote: will the Ministry consider providing support and grants to vet professionals for continuing education?

key_points.point: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik asked whether the Government will engage animal welfare organisations and community caregivers in developing the subsidiary regulations.
key_points.speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik
key_points.quote: will the Government engage the animal welfare organisations and community caregivers in developing the subsidiary regulations under this Bill?

key_points.point: Mr David Hoe asked whether MND will work with MOE on an ITE pathway in the veterinary sector.
key_points.speaker: Mr David Hoe
key_points.quote: I would like to clarify if MND will be working with MOE to explore the possibility of an ITE pathway in the veterinary sector.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Council must comprise at least four other vets, including one with at least 10 cumulative years of experience as a vet.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the Council must also comprise at least four other vets, including one with at least 10 cumulative years of experience as a vet

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Council intends to recognise specialist vets primarily on postgraduate degrees or qualifications and will publish the requirements on its website when ready.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the Council intends to recognise specialist vets primarily based on postgraduate degrees or qualifications, and will publish the requirements on its website when ready

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Bill will not require vets to declare pro bono hours as part of practising certificate renewal.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the Bill will not require vets to declare their pro bono hours as part of the practising certificate renewal requirements

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Complaints Assessment Committee and Disciplinary Committee must complete inquiries within three months and six months respectively, unless the Council allows otherwise.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: clauses 48 and 54 provide that the Complaints Assessment Committee and the Disciplinary Committee must complete its inquiry by three months and six months respectively

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said every complaint must be made in writing and supported by a statutory declaration.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: every complaint must be made in writing and also supported by a statutory declaration

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Registrar will triage each case and can recommend dismissal of frivolous complaints to the Council.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Registrar will objectively assess and triage each case, and can recommend dismissal of frivolous complaints to the Council, so vets are not unduly burdened by cases without merit.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Council will publish disciplinary findings of key cases when concluded.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Council will also publish disciplinary findings of key cases when concluded

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Council will publish a guide to support complainants seeking redress, and a complainant may pursue either or both a Council complaint and a civil proceeding.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: A complainant may pursue either or both, as the circumstances warrant.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Council will publish guidelines before commencement of the relevant provisions next year setting out broad principles of appropriate supervision.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Council will also publish guidelines before the commencement of the relevant provisions next year, setting out the broad principles of the appropriate supervision.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan told community caregivers to continue caring for their animals but to exercise judgement on when to refer them or bring them to a vet.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: To our community caregivers, please continue to care for your animals as you already do, but please also exercise judgement when you need to refer them or to bring them to a vet.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said NParks will continue to support the Veterinary Council as enforcement transitions to the new framework.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: NParks currently undertakes the enforcement of the existing vet licensing framework and will continue to support the Veterinary Council as we transition to the new framework.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said AVS will partner the Council to review the Code of Ethics and will study suggestions for more transparent cost structures such as itemisation of bills and clearer fee disclosures.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: AVS will partner the Council to review the Code of Ethics and will study Members' suggestions for cost structures to be more transparent, such as to provide itemisation of bills and clearer fee disclosures.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Code of Ethics requires vets to explain treatment options, risks and costs, obtain owner consent and avoid unnecessary procedures, and to provide an estimate of fees.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Vets should also provide pet owners with an estimate of fees.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said pet ownership is a personal choice and a long-term commitment, and encouraged prospective owners to consider the full cost of raising a pet.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we strongly encourage prospective pet owners to thoroughly consider the full cost of raising a pet before committing to becoming a pet owner

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said AVS and the Council will partner MOE and the Institutes of Higher Learning to strengthen veterinary-related education and training locally, including for mid-career entrants.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: AVS and the Council will partner stakeholders, such as MOE and the IHLs, to strengthen veterinary-related formal education programmes or training provided locally, including those that may allow mid-career entrants into the sector

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the review includes manpower projections and resource requirements to study the need and feasibility of a local vet degree programme.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we are looking at manpower projections as well as resource requirements to study a local programme

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said AVS will work with the Council to explore initiatives to improve workplace practices and professional development to better support vets, alongside the Protection from Harassment Act.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: While the Protection from Harassment Act protects all individuals, including vets, from harassment, AVS will also work with the Council to explore other initiatives to improve workplace practices and professional development opportunities to better support our vets.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Government is reviewing penalties for animal welfare offences and the licensing regime for pet sector activities, including pet grooming businesses, under the ABA.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we are reviewing the penalties for animal welfare offences and the licensing regime for pet sector activities, including pet grooming businesses under the ABA

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Council is first and foremost a regulator whose primary duty is to maintain professional standards.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Council is, first and foremost, a regulator.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Council President and members are appointed by the Minister, who can also remove members where necessary.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The Veterinary Council President and members are appointed by the Minister, who can also remove members where necessary.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said appeals do not return to the Council and its committees for reconsideration.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Appeals do not return to the Council and the committees for reconsideration

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said vet nurses will be allowed to perform certain vet activities under supervision of a duly qualified vet and in accordance with prescribed conditions, a requirement already in place today.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: vet nurses will be allowed to perform certain vet activities under supervision by a duly qualified vet and in accordance with any prescribed conditions

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Government will continue to engage the vet sector before developing the regulatory framework for vet nurses.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we will continue to engage our vet sector before developing the regulatory framework for them

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said there is no change to the existing 12-month maximum imprisonment term.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: There is no change to the existing 12-month maximum imprisonment term

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Council will work with AVS to raise public awareness of the new requirements and processes, including through the Council's webpage.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: AVS will work with the Council to raise awareness and educate the public on its requirements and processes.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said registration and practising certificate fees will be determined considering current cost trends and the impact on existing practices.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we will consider various factors including current cost trends and the impact on existing practices in determining the prescribed fees

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said pet insurance schemes and professional indemnity insurance schemes are available in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: there are pet insurance schemes available in Singapore to help pet owners with the cost of vet services

key_points.point: Mr Kenneth Tiong asked why vet representation on the Council is not codified on a statutory basis, unlike the Medical Registration Act 1997 and the Dental Registration Act 1999.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: can I just ask the Minister of State to clarify why vet representation is not codified on a statutory basis, unlike the Medical Registration Act of 1997 and the Dental Registration Act of 1999?

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Government is starting on a new slate with the Veterinary Council and will evaluate over time whether such provisions are necessary.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we are starting on a new slate, setting up the Veterinary Council

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan later clarified that vet representation on the Veterinary Council is already codified in the Bill.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the vet representation on the Veterinary Council is already codified in the Bill

key_points.point: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry asked whether MND is open to providing more funding to AVS, noting NParks operates on a lean budget.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
key_points.quote: I do hope that the Government can provide a bit more resources to AVS, to discharge what the public expects of this new regulation regime.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said AVS and NParks will be resourced as necessary for their mission.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: We will resource our AVS and NParks colleagues as necessary for them to conduct their important mission.

key_points.point: Mr Alvin Tan said the Government already has programmes with some polytechnics and will take Mr David Hoe's ITE pathway suggestion into consideration.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: We will take his suggestion into consideration.

what_happens_next: The Minister said the Bill will commence in two stages: establishing the Veterinary Council this year, followed by the remaining provisions including the registration regime and disciplinary framework for vets next year. The transcript does not record the next parliamentary step after the Second Reading debate.
not_said: Whether a locally offered veterinary degree programme will be introduced, and on what timeline.
Whether regulation will be extended to pet groomers and dog trainers, and when.
What the prescribed conditions and supervision arrangements for non-vets, including community caregivers, will say in practice.
Whether a transition period will apply to enforcement against community animal caregivers performing basic first aid.
Whether the exemption power under clause 86 will be used to carve out community animal welfare activities.
Whether fee benchmarks, itemised billing or mandatory fee disclosures will be introduced, and when.
What the registration and practising certificate fees will be.
How many investigators will be appointed and whether a dedicated enforcement unit will be set up.
Whether Industry Abuse Protections will be extended to veterinarians.
Whether an ITE pathway into veterinary or animal care work will be developed.
